claim_summaries: Ordinary fixed-size DPP rejection of the paired-volume event has exact acceptance 2^(1-n) on the n-site cyclic-shift family.
Two-global-partition DPP quotas leave cross-site mismatches; for F=[[1,eps],[eps,1]], target acceptance is eps^2/(1+eps^2), exponentially small in the bit length of eps=2^(-L).
Any positive diagonal item fields preserving both valid target states within fixed factor rho leave acceptance O_rho(eps^2).
The cyclic pair-label polynomial has fractional-log-concavity parameter at most 1/q and sector aperture at most pi/q, excluding the constant-sector down-up transfer.
status: scoped sampler-transfer counterexamples; general pair-volume sampler and field-breaking objective remain open
